author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಜ್ಞಾನಿ ನಾನಾಗಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಿಯನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಲು
ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸು ಎಂದೆನ್ನ ಏಕೆ ಕರೆಯುವಿರಿ
ಸುಜ್ಞಾನ ಪಡೆವುದಕೆ ಮಂಥನವ ಮಾಡುತಿರೆ
ವಿಜ್ಞಾನವನರಿಯುವೆನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When I, the ignorant one, question the wise,
why do you call me a seeker?
if I keep churning to gain true knowledge,
I shall come to know the deeper science, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The poet answers being called a ‘jijñāsu’ (seeker): he only asks because he does not know. By turning questions over patiently, one moves from ignorance toward real understanding.
